candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. No sign say pikin dey convulse now. Dem say e never get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Pikin fit drink or e fit breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Dem count the pikin breath for one full minute. No chest dey go inside when e breathe. Pikin no calm during the assessment. Cough don last 3 days. Dem no use pulse oximeter. No history of recurrent wheeze. Pikin respiratory rate na 35. No stridor when e calm. No wheezing. Pikin no get diarrhoea. Dem say pikin no get ear problem. Dem say pikin no get fever.
